mapper.sql: SELECT TR.TRAVEL_NO travelNo , TR.TRAVEL_NAME travelName , TR.TRAVEL_CONTENT travelContent , TR.TRAVEL_IMAGE travelImage , TR.TRAVEL_STATUS travelStatus , TR.TRAVEL_ADDRESS travelAddress , TR.MAP_X longitude , TR.MAP_Y latitude , TR.COUNT count , RE.REGION_NO regionNo , RE.REGION_NAME regionName , TH.THEME_NO themeNo , TH.THEME_NAME themeName
mapper.select: FROM TB_TRAVEL TR LEFT JOIN TB_REGION RE ON TR.REGION_NO = RE.REGION_NO LEFT JOIN TB_REG_THEME TRT ON TRT.TRAVEL_NO = TR.TRAVEL_NO LEFT JOIN TB_THEME TH ON TH.THEME_NO = TRT.THEME_NO WHERE TR.TRAVEL_STATUS = 'N' AND TR.TRAVEL_NO = #{travelNo} ORDER BY TR.COUNT DESC
